title: Crescent Lake
summary: Crescent Lake Dam which is part of the Crescent Lake Project , is located at the outlet of Crescent Lake. The lake is a large natural body of water formed in a glacial deposit high on the eastern slopes of the Cascade Range. This 4,000-acre lake offers angling opportunities for kokanee salmon, rainbow trout, brown trout, and mountain whitefish. Fishing season runs from late April through October.

The dam, constructed in 1924-1925, is a concrete arch structure with a height of 84 feet and a crest length of 485 feet.
